t: Free slides, posters, videos, and data tools from the Gapminder Foundation.
steps: Open the Gapminder teaching materials page in a web browser.
Download the slides or the World Health Chart poster.
Try the Bubble Charts tool in the browser.
Open Dollar Street to see photos of family homes by income.
Watch one video from the collection before class.
Ask IT to install Gapminder Tools Offline on computers without reliable internet.
Print the poster for the classroom wall.
